items.text: Hello DateZ fans!
This update addresses issues with side scenes not playing or not appearing on the time travel map. We’ve also made some changes and fixes to ensure that certain achievements unlock properly.
Updated conditions and fixed issues with Oriana’s side scenes.
Fixed issues with scenes not appearing on the time travel map (affecting all characters).
Adjusted achievements related to Oriana’s storyline to be connected to her main scenes (Golden path in the time travel map).
Minor fixes to VFX and animations.

releases.displayName: Steam Next Fest is coming soon, and we have big demo update!

items.text: Mark your calendars from October 9th to 16th, when the event launches, because it's going to be a week filled with gaming that you won't want to miss! So many games, so hundreds of demos, and WE are a part of it too!

At the heart of this electrifying event is our very own game, and we're excited to showcase it to you! Get ready for a big update coming to our demo soon, and trust us, you're in for a treat. We're excited about this! 🎉

notes.title: So, what can you expect when you dive into our game during STEAM NEXT FEST?

items.text: Thrilling gameplay that seamlessly melds high school drama, romance, mystery, and heart-pounding action.
Choices that aren't just decisions; they're the building blocks of your destiny, shaping your path in a narrative where every choice COUNTS.
A cast of characters as diverse as the world itself, each with their own captivating storylines and unique personalities.
Date Five Unique Characters: Venture into high school romance with five distinct girls, each with her own individual personality, backstory, and perhaps a part to play in the hidden mystery.
Beautiful Comic-Style Visuals: Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of "Date Z", brought to life by stunning hand-drawn comic-style visuals.
That is not all!
We have prepared a massive translation update for the demo.
You can check the list of the languages available in Date Z below:

Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Spanish - Spain, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese.

Keep in mind, that this is still a "Work in Progress", as creating those translations is very time and money-consuming. That is why you might still encounter some translation bugs here and there - we apologize for that, but we wanted them in the game for the NextFest.
Enjoy!

We're honored to be a part of this incredible celebration of gaming innovation and creativity at STEAM NEXT FEST 2023. It's not just a showcase of our game; it's a celebration of the gaming community and the endless possibilities that lie ahead.
Join us, immerse yourself in our captivating world, and let's begin an unforgettable gaming journey together. Get ready for a week of sheer gaming magic! 🌐🎮
See you on Monday!
